angle_en: The two eternal paths of the world

en.intro: Krishna has just described the path of smoke and night. Now he answers what lies beyond. Listen for the two eternal roads that every soul travels.
en.notice: The two paths are called shuklakrisne, the bright and the dark. One leads to non-return, the other brings the traveler back again, and this is true for the entire world.
en.next: Krishna says the yogi who knows these two paths is never deluded, so remain steadfast in yoga at all times.
en.meaning: The bright and the dark are the two eternal paths of the world. One leads to non-return; the other brings return again.

hi.meaning: शुक्ल और कृष्ण ये दोनों जगत की शाश्वत गतियाँ मानी गई हैं। एक गति से जाने वाले को लौटना नहीं पड़ता और दूसरी गति से जाने वाले को फिर लौटना पड़ता है।
hi.notice: इन दोनों गतियों को शुक्ल और कृष्ण कहा गया है। एक गति से जाने वाले को वापस नहीं आना पड़ता और दूसरी गति से जाने वाले को फिर से लौटना पड़ता है, यह जगत का नियम है।
hi.next: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि जो योगी इन दोनों गतियों को जानता है वह कभी भ्रमित नहीं होता, इसलिए हमेशा योग में स्थिर रहो।

en.intro: Krishna has just described the path of smoke and night. Now he answers what lies beyond. Listen for the two eternal roads that every soul travels.
en.body: The bright and the dark are the two eternal paths of the world. One leads to non-return; the other brings return again. The two paths are called shuklakrisne, the bright and the dark. One leads to non-return, the other brings the traveler back again, and this is true for the entire world. Krishna says the yogi who knows these two paths is never deluded, so remain steadfast in yoga at all times.
